desc: the right code binds the owner's Telegram user and chat
a code older than 10 minutes pairs nothing
a used code pairs nothing a second time
5 wrong tries void the code, even the right one afterwards
/start <code> from a group chat pairs nothing
/start <code> from a bot pairs nothing
/unpair from the bound account removes the binding; later messages are strangers
a stranger is rejected and audited, with no reply and no brain call
the owner's user id in another chat is rejected
a wrong webhook secret is a bare 401 and nothing is parsed
a missing webhook secret is a bare 401 and nothing is parsed
a repeated update_id is processed once
an R2 card is approved by the bound id and runs
another Telegram user cannot approve the owner's R2 card
a forged approve of an R3 card is refused: approve in the console
an R3 card says it waits in the console and raises an alert; nothing runs
gmail_read is refused on Telegram but allowed in the console
with the switch on, an injected email read over Telegram makes writes cards
package tracking (carrier and status only) stays allowed on Telegram
at most 10 alerts an hour
at most 50 alerts a day
the approval alert is the fixed template, never the card's or the model's words
replies are plain text: no parse_mode ever
a long reply is at most 3 messages of at most 4096 characters
